title: BeanCurrentlyInCreationException: circular constructor injection between two services
errorSample:
Caused by: org.springframework.beans.factory.BeanCurrentlyInCreationException: Error creating bean with name 'inventoryService': Requested bean is currently in creation: Is there an unresolvable circular reference or an asynchronous initialization dependency?
	at org.springframework.beans.factory.support.DefaultSingletonBeanRegistry.beforeSingletonCreation(DefaultSingletonBeanRegistry.java:541) ~[spring-beans-7.0.9.jar:7.0.9]
	at org.springframework.beans.factory.support.DefaultSingletonBeanRegistry.getSingleton(DefaultSingletonBeanRegistry.java:310) ~[spring-beans-7.0.9.jar:7.0.9]
	at org.springframework.beans.factory.support.AbstractBeanFactory.doGetBean(AbstractBeanFactory.java:331) ~[spring-beans-7.0.9.jar:7.0.9]
	at org.springframework.beans.factory.support.AbstractBeanFactory.getBean(AbstractBeanFactory.java:201) ~[spring-beans-7.0.9.jar:7.0.9]
	at org.springframework.beans.factory.support.DefaultListableBeanFactory.resolveBean(DefaultListableBeanFactory.java:1232) ~[spring-beans-7.0.9.jar:7.0.9]
	at org.springframework.beans.factory.support.DefaultListableBeanFactory.doResolveDependency(DefaultListableBeanFactory.java:1711) ~[spring-beans-7.0.9.jar:7.0.9]
	at org.springframework.beans.factory.support.DefaultListableBeanFactory.resolveDependency(DefaultListableBeanFactory.java:1658) ~[spring-beans-7.0.9.jar:7.0.9]
	at org.springframework.beans.factory.support.ConstructorResolver.resolveAutowiredArgument(ConstructorResolver.java:912) ~[spring-beans-7.0.9.jar:7.0.9]
	at org.springframework.beans.factory.support.ConstructorResolver.createArgumentArray(ConstructorResolver.java:791) ~[spring-beans-7.0.9.jar:7.0.9]
symptom: The application context fails to start with an UnsatisfiedDependencyException whose root cause is BeanCurrentlyInCreationException ("Requested bean is currently in creation: Is there an unresolvable circular reference"). Two singleton beans each take the other as a constructor parameter.
cause: Since Spring Boot 2.6 circular references between beans are prohibited by default. A cycle made of constructor parameters can never be resolved by the container anyway, because neither bean can be instantiated before the other.
fixSummary: Break the cycle instead of relaxing the check: move the state both services need into a third bean and let both depend on it, or mark one constructor parameter with @Lazy so a lazy-resolution proxy is injected. Setting spring.main.allow-circular-references=true does not resolve constructor cycles and is discouraged.
